bio.text: Ed Hershey is the Working Class Party candidate for Illinois' 4th Congressional District in 2026.

According to the Sun-Times, he has taught at Lindblom Math and Science Academy in West Englewood for 16 years, has served as a union representative, and ran for alderman of Chicago's 25th Ward in 2015.

sources.title: What to know about the 4th Congressional District race to replace U.S. Rep. Jesus 'Chuy' Garcia
